question: Does retaining one prior partial-observation cue materially improve actual reward and termination success on independent upstream MiniGrid Memory tasks compared with the exact same hand-programmed navigation policy after the cue is discarded?
hypothesis: Under equal navigation/action budget and deterministic simulator seeds, explicit one-item cue retention improves success >=25pp in both 11x11 fixed and 13x13 variable-length memory environments, while strictly using public observations and no simulator internals.
predecessor_evidence: AAI-06A PR #1032 valid negative, source exact SHA eccf96d2bee7b97ec74591b9a07813d8c1eb6f08
AAI-07P source pinned at 64e1eaec904bc35e7de041167274e2c0dfe541d2, Git memory.py blob 660b0a1b769948034c87bb421759c2b9a4f24548

AAI-07P mechanical preflight run 43607704764 PASS Linux/Windows identical trace SHA256 444132c9e739a8eaf671d699c595c4bed5a03f4fdb14b5e3d07e74b5bd2a0cc6; original working-tree source text differed Windows CRLF/LF, canonical source Git blob same
AAI-07P navigator mechanical run 43608092293 PASS, 8 reserved seeds per environment. Memo+rule agent 8/8 versus reactive 4/8 in each; development-only, used for design, scientific seeds untouched.

inputs.name: Upstream MiniGrid Memory benchmark canonical published Git content
inputs.acquisition: git fetch --depth 1 exact commit then detached checkout; git show HEAD:path byte-SHA256; pinned dependencies

frozen_design.split: Independent env sizes and world seeds. Never use reserved mechanical seeds for confirmatory measurements.
frozen_design.ordering: For each seed, run observation-only remembered-cue and identical navigation with discarded cue on independent reset from same seed; no cross-arm learning; env reset and actions deterministic. Both evaluate actual official step reward, termination and fixed public action budget.
frozen_design.data_budget: 64 paired episodes in each of 2 upstream environments; each arm max 120 actions, 1 binary/key-ball cue accessible only to memory condition
frozen_design.compute_budget: 1024 paired bootstrap draws per environment, seed 17070; single first-use evaluation on Ubuntu Python 3.12; no training/paid API
frozen_design.capacity: One key-or-ball cue retained by memory arm; reactive condition discards after initial observation. Same scripted navigator and action interfaces.
frozen_design.evaluator: Unmodified navigator_probe.py git source from initial AAI-07 preflight; evaluate memory vs ablation, reward and success on held-out worlds with paired exact McNemar p and bootstrap 95% CI, deterministic result receipt hash.
frozen_design.no_hidden_data: No use of env.unwrapped, grid, agent_pos, goal positions, secret cue or mission text; learner receives only image/direction/action/reward/termination. Public code constants allowed.

controls: Identical hand-coded navigation, reactive cue-erasure negative condition (cue not retained)
Common frozen episode seeds and observation/action policy; no extra environment samples or privileged labels
Original external environment unmodified; raw Git object source identity verified
State-space and variable hallway length transfer tested on a different environment
metrics: Per-environment success fraction, mean official reward and actions
Paired discordance/mcnemar exact two-sided p-value and seed-level bootstrap CI
Negative reactive baseline success fraction bounded 0.25..0.75

classification_rules.supported: Memory arm success >=0.85 and success improvement >=0.25 in BOTH cohorts; bootstrap 95% lower bound positive for both; combined exact McNemar p<0.01; reactive success each between 0.25 and 0.75; no hidden-state access; official source custody PASS. This only admits the benchmark as memory-sensitive, not a learning mechanism.
classification_rules.mixed: Meaningful gain on only one environment or any other sound partial result fails benchmark-admission thresholds; no model integration.
classification_rules.negative: Sound test shows <25pp in any environment, reactive saturates, or memory fails >=85%; preserve as negative, no post-result tuning.
classification_rules.invalid: Unqualified source/input identity, hidden simulator state or hints, extra intervention budget, mismatched data, nondeterminism or changed source, thresholds or seeds; classify separately from negative.

limitations: The cue matching rule and route are explicitly human-programmed: success is NOT evidence of learned association, new causal mechanism, genuine unknown dynamics, autonomous navigation, long-run model interference resistance, or AGI.
prohibited_after_primary_run: extra evaluation data or replay of consumed seeds
